data.one_liner: Dart and Flutter client for the open-source Nakama game server.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs for user authentication, real-time multiplayer, chat, social features, and custom RPCs interacting with a Nakama game server. It includes support for web sockets, sessions management, and requests handling.
use_when: You are building a game or app powered by a Nakama backend server.
You need cross-platform support for real-time multiplayer, chat, or social features in Dart/Flutter.
avoid_when: You are using a non-Nakama backend service like Firebase, Supabase, or Appwrite.
You do not need a dedicated game server backend.
strengths: Comprehensive client library for Nakama server features including multiplayer and matchmaker.
Cross-platform support across iOS, Android, Web, and desktop.
weaknesses: Requires a running Nakama server and database setup.
Breaking changes can require code adjustments when updating (e.g., score types).
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up a Nakama server and database (typically via Docker) before connecting with the client.
